title: Pure Of the Swamp
summary: Pure Of the Swamp shapeshifter Fusion build uniting King of the Swamp, Beastking of the Swamps, Mudragon of the Swamp, Swamp Mirrorer, Quantum Cat, and Swamp Battleguard. Fusion Substitute monsters and Type/Attribute-declaring Continuous Trap Monsters let Polymerization and Super Polymerization fuse your board or the opponent's into any Extra Deck payoff.

summary.title: Starters
points: King of the Swamp discards itself from the hand to search Polymerization from the Deck, or substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material in the hand, field, or GY.
Keeper of Dragon Magic discards a card on Normal or Special Summon to search Polymerization or Super Polymerization, and revives a named Fusion Material from the GY.
Fusion Recycling Plant discards 1 card to search Polymerization from the Deck or GY, and recovers 1 Fusion Material used for a Fusion Summon from your GY during the End Phase.

summary.title: Opening: Keeper of Dragon Magic + King of the Swamp
steps: Discard King of the Swamp to search Polymerization, then Normal Summon Keeper of Dragon Magic and discard a card to search Super Polymerization.

Fuse King of the Swamp (or Beastking of the Swamps) with an Effect Monster using Polymerization into Millennium-Eyes Restrict or Mudragon of the Swamp (or fuse an Extra Deck monster and a monster in hand into Magnum the Reliever).
Set Swamp Mirrorer, Quantum Cat, and Super Polymerization; during the End Phase, Fusion Recycling Plant recovers King of the Swamp from the GY to your hand.

summary.title: Swamp Mirrorer & Quantum Cat Custom Fusions
summary.text: Swamp Mirrorer (1800 ATK / 100 DEF) and Quantum Cat (0 ATK / 2200 DEF) are Continuous Traps that Special Summon themselves as Level 4 Normal Monsters with any Monster Type and Attribute you declare on activation. On the opponent's turn, you can flip Swamp Mirrorer or Quantum Cat, declare the exact Attribute and Type that matches (or differs from) an opponent's boss monster, and chain Super Polymerization to fuse their monster with your Trap Monster into Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Payoff
points: Mudragon of the Swamp (2 monsters with the same Attribute and different Types) prevents the opponent from targeting it or any monster on the field sharing its Attribute with card effects, and changes its Attribute as a Quick Effect.
Garura, Wings of Resonant Life (2 monsters with the same Type and Attribute) deals double battle damage and draws 1 card when sent to the GY.

Millennium-Eyes Restrict (made with King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps substituting for Relinquished) absorbs and negates opposing monsters when they activate their effects; Tearlaments Rulkallos (made with King/Beastking substituting for Tearlaments Kitkallos + an Aqua) negates Special Summon effects.

Predaplant Dragostapelia and Starving Venom Fusion Dragon punish DARK boards, Magnum the Reliever recycles Polymerization to draw and pop cards, and Number 101: Silent Honor ARK (2 Level 4 WATER monsters: Beastking, Mudragon, or WATER-declared Swamp Mirrorer/Quantum Cat) absorbs an opponent's Special Summoned monster.

summary.title: Spells
points: Super Polymerization fuses monsters from either field at Spell Speed 4 with no opponent response allowed.
Instant Fusion (Limited) pays 1000 LP to Special Summon Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp or Level 1 Millennium-Eyes Restrict directly from the Extra Deck.

main: King of the Swamp
Core Level 3 WATER Aqua: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, OR discards itself from your hand to add 1 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand.
Beastking of the Swamps

Core Level 4 WATER Aqua: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material on a Fusion Monster, and pairs with Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp or Swamp Mirrorer to Xyz Summon Rank 4 Number 101: Silent Honor ARK!
Swamp Battleguard
Classic EARTH Warrior 'of the Swamp' monster that serves as a different-Type fusion body alongside your WATER/EARTH shapeshifters.
Keeper of Dragon Magic
Discards 1 card on Normal or Special Summon to search Polymerization or Super Polymerization, and revives a Fusion Material from your GY.
Polymerization
Fuses King of the Swamp or Beastking of the Swamps with any Effect Monster into Millennium-Eyes Restrict, Mudragon of the Swamp, or Magnum the Reliever.
Super Polymerization

Fuses 2 monsters on either field into Mudragon of the Swamp (same Attribute, different Types) or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life (same Type and Attribute)—effortlessly enabled by Swamp Mirrorer and Quantum Cat!
Instant Fusion
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 4 WATER Mudragon of the Swamp directly from your Extra Deck.
Fusion Recycling Plant
Searches Polymerization by discarding a card and recovers King of the Swamp from your GY during the End Phase.
Swamp Mirrorer

Signature Continuous Trap Monster: declares 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 Normal Monster (1800 ATK / 100 DEF) with that exact Type and Attribute—custom-tailoring the exact Type/Attribute needed for Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura!
Quantum Cat
Companion Swamp Continuous Trap Monster: declares 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute to Special Summon itself as a Level 4 Normal Monster (0 ATK / 2200 DEF) with that exact Type and Attribute!
